scope.fileCoverage: All 66 current native packages: FCStd sources, model descriptors, USDZ assets, and existing suspension/physics authoring metadata; checksum manifest is evidence, not a build lock.

fieldRules.passed: An optional integrityPassed field may reflect these current checks; never import inherited passed=true as runtime validation.
fieldRules.assetCommit: Set only after a concrete committed combined tree is identified; otherwise record both integration refs and current file identities.
fieldRules.installedDelivery: Reference fresh combined install/staging evidence with its exact build, manifest, descriptor and model hashes. Preserve inherited fields only under historicalRecords.
fieldRules.legacyPathList: Retain the 135-path comparisons as reconciliation evidence; do not write hashes for the retired generated board.json or reactivate docs/model-delivery-lock.json.

proposedFreshCombinedRecord.historicalRecordsMeaning: Retained raw files preserve every original field byte-for-byte; their inherited passed/count/simulator/review fields are not promoted into current claims.

recommendation: Publish a fresh offline combined integrity record and current checksum manifest; retain inherited delivery/install statuses and review-specific claims by source path and exact hash. Use fresh root install/runtime evidence separately when available.

retiredLegacyPaths.reason: Runtime manifest is now generated from the real native CAD source; an authored board.json is absent by policy.

proposedFreshInstalledRecordSchema.fieldRule: Replace null values only with hash-bound fresh combined install/build/runtime evidence. Preserve old review-specific statuses and simulator IDs solely in retained historical records.
